author: marciepeters

test_results.notes: Merge conflicts prevent CI from running. Cannot build/test locally without cherry-picking.

lessons: Provider PRs touch ~32 files in a predictable pattern across types/schemas/CLI/webview/handler/fetcher/docs layers
Use capability flags (supportsReasoningBudget/supportsReasoningEffort) instead of model-name prefix matching for reasoning param detection
RouterProvider base class handles most OpenAI-compatible provider boilerplate; child classes only need getModel customization
Community PRs from provider employees tend to have above-average test coverage and integration completeness
